concerns.text: Task T011 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but its function `update_state_hashes()` writes a single `state/projects/PROJ-055‑...yaml` file that is also invoked as the final step of every pipeline script. Concurrent execution of multiple pipeline scripts would cause race conditions on this shared file, violating the parallel‑safety guarantee. The `[P]` tag should be removed or the implementation must serialize access to the state‑hash file (e.g., via file locking or a dedicated aggregation step).
